quest.title: Lightkeepers' Oath
quest.description: This is the pledge all must take when they become Lightkeepers.
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x150, Mora x20000, Adventurer's Experience x4

dialogues.speaker: Flins
dialogues.text: Hello there, friend. A pleasure to meet you again amidst the graves.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You describe the "Oath Lantern" you saw and the incomprehensible words inscribed upon it.

dialogues.speaker: Flins
dialogues.text: "The winds awaken, the leaves whirl round"... This is the oath those who join the Lightkeepers swear.

dialogues.speaker: Flins
dialogues.text: Usually, each of us will carry our own lantern, only abandoning our charge to care for it when we have no other choice.

dialogues.speaker: Flins
dialogues.text: Each masterless lantern, therefore, is a marker of misfortune, a tragedy that fills me with sorrow.

dialogues.speaker: Flins
dialogues.text: But they knew that such would be their inevitable fate from the moment they made their oaths.

dialogues.speaker: Flins
dialogues.text: If there was anything else we could do for them, it would be remembering the oaths they made.

dialogues.speaker: Flins
dialogues.text: To bear and defend "lanterns alight with eternal hope"... That was their dearest wish.

talks.objective: Find someone who understands the Lightkeepers' Oath
